snippet.title: The Emerald Flower Theory | Trailer 1
snippet.description:
Game page:
https://gamejolt.com/games/TEFT/779186
Music from the trailer: 
https://youtu.be/LmthKci9PgE?si=b5_D2dQuIvlbVOf_

The trailer was shown at the event
​ ⁨@TheWorldboticBroadcast⁩  

Sensation! The world-famous inventor Martin Serafor has disappeared under mysterious circumstances!

He was last seen in the recently acquired bunker-workshop AFTC01 - the very place where mascot robots are being developed for the upcoming amusement park of Steven Delone, creator of the popular animated show “The Adventures of Fluffy the Cat” Representatives of the interim management at GreenFun Robotics assure that the situation is under control and the search for Martin will continue.

The public is already speculating about what happened. Over the past year, Martin repeatedly mentioned a secret project into which he poured all his energy. He called it the “Emerald Flower” - a project that promises to revolutionize the entertainment industry.

But what lies behind this mysterious name? Is the government-or even extraterrestrial forces-involved in the inventor’s disappearance? Who could have taken him, and why?

Despite these VERY troubling news, we invite you to work as a night technician in the AFTC01 bunker. You MUST love creepy atmospheres, terrifying-looking robots, wander through eerie corridors, and maintain order in the workshop so that daytime staff can work comfortably.

But…you came here to uncover the truth, didn’t you?
